method.class: Split (inductive) conformal prediction-set procedures for compositional (softmax, sum-to-one) classifier outputs, scored by an evaluator-owned multi-axis reliability protocol
method.description: The candidate supplies the conformal procedure (nonconformity score, calibration, set construction) under program_0/src behind handle(request)->response (reset / chunked calibrate / chunked predict over base64 float32 probabilities, int16 labels, packbits masks). The evaluator generates synthetic softmax-output families in memory (K in {10,50,100}; exchangeable, temperature-miscalibrated, long-tailed prior, heteroscedastic, covariate/label shift), holds all test labels privately, and scores marginal coverage, class/size/difficulty-stratified worst-slice coverage gap and mean set size; it also runs evaluator-implemented LAC, APS, RAPS, classwise, uncalibrated top-mass and trivial baselines on identical data and three negative controls (C1 permuted calibration labels, C2 shuffled test labels, C3 constant uniform input). Claims do not extend to real datasets, K>100, n_cal<200, simplex-valued regression targets, or shifts beyond the declared families; shift-case coverage is descriptive.

artifacts.source: Evaluator-authored synthetic generator parameters for search cases S1-S4 (no external data)

Truncated SHA-256 content hashes (float32 row bytes + label) of every search-plane generated example, produced by evaluate.py's generator; lets evaluate_final.py verify cross-plane disjointness without reading the search root

baselines: Trivial references: full label set and argmax-only singleton
Negative controls C1 permuted calibration labels, C2 shuffled test labels, C3 constant uniform input
protocol.promotion_rule: Search-correct (integrity and scientific validity only; no baseline-superiority threshold): all 15 episodes well-formed within deadline, reset transcript exact, content-hash/seed disjointness passed, C1-C3 non-vacuous and meeting predeclared expected behaviour, and seed-averaged marginal coverage on exchangeable cases S1-S3 >= 1-alpha minus a 3-sigma finite-sample tolerance. Eligible candidates are ranked by highest combined_score, ties by lower mean_set_size_ratio, then lower worst_slice_coverage_gap, then earlier cycle; the best eligible candidate is frozen before final. Final-correct is stated separately (all 36 episodes well-formed, exact transcript, cross-plane disjointness, six controls passed, exchangeable F1/F2/F3/F5 coverage within tolerance); final claim wording (supported / refuted / conditional) follows score_margin_vs_best_baseline and its bootstrap interval and is not a search veto.

search_proxies.name: synthetic_search_manifest
search_proxies.preserves: Wire protocol, chunking, scoring loss, baselines, negative controls, aggregation hierarchy, and the four case families (exchangeable, miscalibrated small-n_cal, long-tailed K=100, shift)
search_proxies.omits: Final-only families (K=50 heteroscedastic alpha=0.05, K=100 strong shift alpha=0.2), the final parameter draws and the sealed final seeds

search_proxies.name: three_seed_search_budget
search_proxies.preserves: Per-episode data size, deadlines and per-seed loss definition
search_proxies.omits: Statistical power of the five final seeds, the best-baseline margin metrics and bootstrap intervals, which exist only in the final plane

search_visible: per-case aggregate coverage, set-size ratio and slice-gap summaries for S1-S4 and per-control pass/fail reason on evaluator stderr
search seeds, search case manifest parameters, and permitted workload request fields (K, alpha, n_cal, n_test)
final_sealed: final seeds and final case manifest
final_score and all final metrics, per-case/per-seed/per-slice results and control outcomes
evaluator baseline results and score margin with intervals
final-correct verdict, content-hash overlap report, evaluator-private labels and generator internals

required_evidence: Pinned scaffold provenance: candidate code digest frozen before final, evaluator/contract digests, numpy version, role-local CPU allocation, task.md SHA-256

Scaffold-time wire preflight of the largest 1000x100 request and response (UTF-8 JSON bytes incl. base64 expansion, envelope, framing) strictly below 64 MiB, and per-episode RPC tally (1 reset + 2 calibrate + 4 predict = 7) giving max_candidate_rpc_calls 105 (search) and 252 (final)
Exact reset transcripts for search (15), search smoke (4), final (36), final smoke (4); one reset per episode; no replay
Smoke runs of both planes with measured wall-clock, explicitly not attesting full-workload completion
Actual search evaluations with metrics, eligibility verdicts, ranking and freeze record; failed or incomplete cycles reported as such
Actual final metrics with per-case results, evaluator baselines, control outcomes and bootstrap interval; explicit statement of which case families support, refute or leave inconclusive the claim
Negative-control evidence: non-vacuity checks and expected-vs-observed behaviour of C1-C3 in both planes; a vacuous control is a design failure, not a causal conclusion
Data-disjointness evidence: empty content-hash intersection across planes, no duplicate examples within a plane, disjoint seeds and case manifests; no evaluator-private data crossing RPC
Enforcement boundaries: plane wall-clock, per-RPC and per-episode deadlines and RPC cap are enforced; candidate-internal counts are advisory and untrusted
Limitations: synthetic-only softmax-classification sets, bounded K/n_cal/alpha ranges, ungated descriptive shift cases, no extrapolation beyond declared families
